bugs.description: Variant B (17 Tesseract training EXEs removed) passed full multilingual audit_packet parity (audit_ok=true).
Loop 17/18 profiling latency misses on Windows Tesseract 5.4.0.

On single-column raster pages without native PDF text, adaptive_ocr.py runs profile_document() (eng+hin+ori) + execute_adaptive_ocr() (2nd Tesseract spawn), costing 2280.03 ms vs 1220.94 ms for single-pass eng+hin+ori.

profile_document() used timeout=2 for lang='eng+hin+ori', causing non-deterministic timeouts (~2.0-2.16s) on Windows Tesseract 5.4.0 that silently fell back to LATIN (FAST_PATH_ENG) on Hindi and bilingual documents. Fixed to timeout=8; Loop 15-17 suites now pass 26/26.
